landing.landing_title: The Future of LaTeX Editing is Collaborative
landing.landing_subtitle: Create, edit, and compile your LaTeX documents in real-time, with integrated Git version control and simplified collaboration.
landing.feature1_description: With a single click, see the changes in your PDF without the need to compile manually.
landing.feature2_description: Each project is a Git repository, allowing you to version your work efficiently.
landing.feature3_description: Organize your documents into multiple projects, making it easy to manage and organize your work.
landing.testimonial1_text: Superfolha has revolutionized the way I write my papers. The real-time compilation is magic!
landing.testimonial2_text: The best tool for collaborating on LaTeX documents I've ever used. The Git integration is seamless.
landing.testimonial3_text: Finally a modern solution for LaTeX. The interface is clean, intuitive, and very powerful.
landing.final_cta_subtitle: Join thousands of developers and academics who are already using Superfolha.
